blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Ian Torres stepped into the spotlight in the College of St. Benilde’s 82-77 squeaker over Mapua in Group A of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at Philsports Arena on Friday. Torres hit the big shots down the stretch and finished with 15 points, two rebounds and two assists to lift the Blazers to a 3-1 record. “I was just open at times,” Torres said of his heroics. “I just took them because I was open.
